All three receipts report exit_code=0 and child_returncode=0. Log SHA256 respectively 882616a4994bbd38527dee70b6329a7089da4bd43e1d03eea27a92b6edab2537, ccd9e3ebeddaf5da3fc5562c863dc434f53f8551d91bfc7294a9f9c0a63ff186, 04354c41fa7c1348e5a286de7f4c36e3bb5ab2661ddc9c754a48c55a6146a095.

Evidence covers rectangular signed scalar/form agreement, actual backward adjoints, pair reversal, nominal axes, lazy opening, one-shot scalar refusal, width-one operator execution and scale-aware contractions. Approval is a candidate review only: it grants no landing authorization, resolves no pending ancestor, and makes no upstream Alder publication/pin or M1.06 qualification claim.
